MODIFIED (HAND SCULPTOR, 2026-10-04): vision_bundle.mjs and vision_bundle.js have the built-in usage logger
disabled (the logger constructor sets an error instead of starting its 60 s flush timer), so no usage data is
sent to odml.pa.googleapis.com. Everything else is the unmodified npm @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.0.1 build.
